transactions.counterparty: Elite Phoenix Limited (related corporation of the Manager, via Elite Dram Limited)
transactions.citation: p25 Acquisitions table: 'Custom House, Felixstowe ... Home Office | 3.4 | 3.7 | 20 Jun 25'; 'Merlin House, Carmarthen ... DEFRA | 1.8 | 2.3 | 20 Jun 25'; 'Priory Court, Dover ... Home Office | 4.0 | 4.7 | 20 Jun 25' (columns: purchase price GBPm, valuation GBPm); Note 32 IPT related-party consideration GBP9,200k
transactions.notes: AGGREGATE deal: three properties acquired together from a related corporation of the Manager (Elite Phoenix Limited via Elite Dram Limited) for a combined GBP9.2m; single deal_id covering all three. Per-property purchase/valuation (GBP million): Custom House 3.4/3.7, Merlin House 1.8/2.3, Priory Court 4.0/4.7; sums to 9.2/10.7. gain_loss_pct = (9,200,000-10,700,000)/10,700,000 = -14.02% (acquired below the aggregate independent valuation by Colliers as at 31 Dec 2025). Acquisition cost recognised in investment properties GBP9,644,000 (Note 4, includes transaction costs); cash outflow GBP9,644k. Manager commentary separately cites a 7.6% discount to the average of Colliers+CBRE valuations, not used here (per-basis valuation preferred). Partially funded by a GBP4.0m private placement and net divestment proceeds from Hilden House, Warrington.

transactions.citation: p26 Divestments table: 'Hilden House, Warrington | North West | Caro Developments Ltd | 3.3 | 3.1[8] | 14 May 25'
transactions.notes: One of two vacant properties classified as held-for-sale at 31 Dec 2024, contracted 26 Nov 2024, completed 14 May 2025. gain_loss_pct = (3,300,000-3,100,000)/3,100,000 = +6.45% vs CBRE valuation as at 30 Jun 2024 (footnote 8 valuation date). Per-property net gain/loss NOT split in FS — only a COMBINED FY2025 net divestment loss of GBP80,000 (P&L) against combined net proceeds GBP5,670,000 (cash-flow statement) across all four divestments. Manager commentary: 'the four properties were divested at an average 5% premium' (p684) — aggregate commentary figure, not used per-property.
